title: Curriculum Designer, Skillet
jobDescription: Skillet is an AI-powered platform for roleplay, manager coaching, and call preparation built for life sciences commercial teams. We help teams practice the high-stakes conversations that matter most, from product launches and customer interactions to manager coaching and field readiness, because when it comes to practice, realism drives results. Skillet operates under the Wayground brand with its own dedicated focus and mission. We are building a new way for life sciences organizations to prepare their teams for critical conversations by combining deep domain understanding, thoughtful curriculum design, and AI-powered simulations. We are looking for a Curriculum Designer who can translate business goals, complex life sciences products, and real-world commercial scenarios into clear learning objectives and highly realistic practice experiences. You will work at the intersection of life sciences, learning design, and AI, shaping how commercial teams prepare for conversations that directly impact their effectiveness in the field.
